correctness.rationale: Exact identity d(i,j)=2(H-t_MRCA), square-sum expansion over rooted edges, strictly convex unit-flow energy, and elementary series/parallel least-energy principle prove maximum Rao diversity equals 2(H-R). Positive terminal conductance gives unique strictly positive weights. Binary min-resistance Bellman recursion has O(n k^2) rational split operations. Root conductance is strictly increasing and monotone submodular by concave branch transformations, making reciprocal-resistance decreases strictly diminish for nested nonempty sets. Actual embedded verify.py was executed: 3690 exact inverse-covariance vs conductance comparisons, 405 DP/exhaustive comparisons, 83970 strict triple checks. This empirical corroboration is not the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: The exact biodiversity-conservation problem with a fixed number of retained taxa and freely optimized abundances is a motivated joint discrete/continuous optimization benchmark. The polynomial-time solution and strict seeded-diminishing-returns boundary distinguish it from both numerical fixed-set Rao maximization and greedy edge-union phylogenetic diversity. The formula also recovers exact rational optimal species weights. The idealized unrestricted abundance and molecular-clock assumptions are clearly delimited.
